DETAILS: Sandy Paws is a delightful 3-bedroom, 3-bathroom home in the “paw-pular” Seagrove Beach neighborhood—only a 2-minute bike ride to the white sandy shores! Offering 1,850 square feet of pet-friendly living space, a fenced-in backyard, and a spacious private pool deck, it comfortably accommodates up to 10 guests with furry BFFs. Guests will love biking to Seaside for charming boutique shopping and a taste of the famous food trucks or venturing to the Seagrove Beach Market for a sweet treat.

Embodying seaside sophistication, this beautifully decorated home flows seamlessly within an open floor plan that's bathed in natural light, illuminating the serene beige and creamy white coastal palette. Plush, slip-covered furniture beckons with its soft and inviting charm, balancing laid-back comfort and understated luxury. Whether it's a quiet conversation or mapping out the day's activities, the living area was designed to bring the whole family together. A fully equipped kitchen featuring high-end appliances, pantry, and Keurig-Duo coffee maker is perfect for preparing breakfast, lunch, or dinner. The nearby dining table seats 6 in a circle, plus 4 more at the adjacent breakfast bar, providing ample space for shared meals. The heart of the home lies in the sprawling outdoor haven, complete with a large pool deck and fenced-in backyard. Soak up the sun next to the peaceful private pool or sip cocktails from the alfresco table for 4 while the kids and dogs play freely in the yard. After a busy day at the beach, take advantage of the convenient washer and dryer, then unwind in 3 comfortable bedrooms, each with a TV. The luxurious primary bedroom features a king bed, private bathroom, and easy outdoor access. A welcoming guest room with a queen bed sits alongside a playful bunk room featuring 2 twin-over-full beds, perfect for kids!

Bask in the charm of Sandy Paws, perfect for adventures with furry pals! Enjoy on-site parking for 4 vehicles, and an EV charger. For trails and sidewalks, take the 3 complimentary adult bikes—shop in Seaside in 6 minutes and dine at Surfing Deer in 4 minutes. For beach access, bike 2 minutes to Greenwood Beach!

*Guests who are 25 years of age or younger must be accompanied by a responsible parent or guardian in any vacation rental managed by Callista by 360 Blue. We do not rent homes to those 25 years of age or younger who are unaccompanied by a responsible parent or guardian. Moreover, there must be a ratio of at least (1) parent or guardian over the age of 25 for every four (4) young adults who are 25 years of age or younger.

Moreover, there must be a ratio of at least (1) parent or guardian over the age of 25 for every four (4) young adults who are 25 years of age or younger.

*This home is pet-friendly for up to 2 dogs, 60 pounds or less, and non-aggressive breeds only, with an additional non-refundable pet fee of $400, plus tax.

*The Peloton is not for guest use.

*The living room fireplace is not for guest use.
Our prices include all fees. No hidden fees.

reviews.text: The property was perfect. Location, amenities- including pool, grill, fire pit and especially the golf cart were amazing. The beds.... awesome. I'd like to know what brand it is and the bedding. I would order it for my home. Side note, a bottle of tanqueray gin was left in the lower dresser drawer by accident. If it was not discarded, consider it a gift for the next guest or owner. The one negative I would say is that the floor carpet mat in the primary bathroom was dirty and cleaning towels were left in the front room on the credenza by the TV. Not a big deal, but something to pay attention to keep your five-star ratings. I would return the property. Everyone enjoyed themselves!
